answer: Continuous attention escrow makes each identity answer random micro-tasks at unpredictable intervals and hold a vault balance that decays on misses. A missed challenge freezes payouts and releases part of the balance; a falcon monitor flags delegated or bursty replies. Each identity spends about 12 minutes of verified work daily, so an attacker pays that attention labor plus forfeited balances; a walnut-sized budget of cheap accounts cannot keep payouts open.
